# Rafiq v0.5.3: Office files, ready-made templates, and a clearer chat

PowerPoint and Excel in proper Arabic, ready-made documents that ask for what's missing, a
reasoning level in the model menu, and a chat that shows how the model thinks and what it does.

---

## 📊 PowerPoint and Excel

- **PowerPoint decks** from an outline: a title slide, one slide per heading, bullets that sit
  on the right and read right to left, tables that read from the right, an Arabic font, a light
  or a dark look.
- **Excel, read:** any .xlsx or .csv — the rows as a table, and for every column of numbers the
  sum, average, minimum and maximum.
- **Excel, written:** numbers given as text become real numbers, formulas work (`=SUM(B2:B5)`),
  Arabic sheets read right to left, and a bar, line or pie chart can come with it — a totals
  row stays out of the chart.
- **Word, PowerPoint and Excel work in every chat**, even without a folder: the files go to
  `Documents\Rafiq\documents`.

## 📄 Ready-made templates

- **A research paper, a CV, a work report, an invoice, a slide deck.** Pick one, fill in what
  you know (every field is optional), and the model asks for whatever is still missing in one
  short list — then writes the file.
- From the Home page ("Templates…") or **Ctrl+K → Templates**.

## 🧠 How hard the model thinks

- **A reasoning level inside the model menu** — on Home and in the chat: Auto, Light, Medium
  or High, in a list that opens under it. It applies to the chat; on Home, to the chat it starts.
- **The model menu on Home** is drawn on the page's surface now, so white and dark brand marks
  both show.

## 💬 A clearer chat

- **The thinking as a chain of steps,** each folding open to the whole thought. In design and
  motion sessions it stays folded behind an arrow until you open it.
- **Replies arrive word by word** at an even pace instead of in lumps.
- **Tool cards say what's happening:** "reading notes.md…" while it runs, then what it did; the
  arguments in one line, the full input a click away, JSON output pretty-printed, and
  "Interrupted" when a reply stopped before the tool answered.
- **@ shows the folder's files as a tree,** the one you're on highlighted.
- **A task's changes read like a commit:** files grouped by folder, line counts per file and per
  folder, and the diff of any one file a click away.

## 🖼️ Pictures for every model

- **A new tool lets the model look at any image in the folder.** A model that can see gets the
  picture; one that can't (DeepSeek, many local models) gets a detailed description from the
  vision model chosen in Settings.

## ✨ And

- **A globe turning slowly behind the pages,** the region's cities pulsing on it. It rests while
  the window is hidden; switch it off in Settings → General.
- **Motion: fold the chat away** for the whole editor — a reply keeps streaming while it's
  hidden.

---

The globe is drawn with [cobe](https://github.com/shuding/cobe) (MIT, by Shu Ding). See
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.5.3_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.3_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
